children.text: I'm an AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer focused on building practical, production-oriented AI systems — retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent automation. My experience spans backend architecture, role-based access systems, and modern AI/LLM tooling. I care about shipping things that actually work end-to-end, not just demos.

experience.summary: Implemented fine-grained RBAC and access control across HRMS modules (Admin, HR, Manager, Employee). Developed permission-based APIs and workspace-scoped authorization mechanisms. Built Asset Management workflows — inventory, assignments, requests, approvals, returns. Implemented bulk asset assignment and lifecycle management with transactional database operations. Contributed to a multi-tenant ERP platform using Django, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Docker, Celery, RabbitMQ.
Developed an E-Commerce application with secure authentication and REST APIs. Implemented JWT-based authorization and improved frontend UX. Worked with React.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Postman.
